item.title: Keep your wearable's own readings
item.summary: When your wearable and Apple Health both report a daily reading, Murph now prefers the wearable's own data over the health-store copy.
item.details: Your resting-heart-rate chart stays with a recently reporting wearable, so a later Apple Health sync cannot switch its source. Health-store readings remain available when no recent wearable reports RHR. Steps keep their existing worn-device coverage rule.
